description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 12.08.2019 to 18.08.2019
categorisation: This gazette notification establishes new exchange rates for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It is a regulatory instrument issued by the Director General of Customs, exercising powers vested by law. The content focuses on legal compliance requirements and financial regulations, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5).
